deck.title: Claims Handling Change Journeys: First Notice of Loss to Settlement
deck.kicker: Northwind Mutual · Claims Transformation Alignment Deck

personas.mission: Captures the loss event, confirms coverage against the policy, and validates the repair estimate so that each claim starts clean and moves to settlement without rework.

image.alt: Claims adjuster team working at a contact centre

slides.title: First Notice of Loss: Intake Normalisation

as_is.body: Call-centre agents retype caller details from paper notes into the claims core. Average handling time is 22 minutes and 14% of records contain data-entry errors.

to_be.body: The intake agent structures the call into a claim event record and the human agent only confirms the summary. Target is 9 minutes handling time and under 2% entry errors.

as_is.body: The adjuster reads the PDF policy by hand to confirm coverage and deductible, adding about 1.5 days before any other work can start.

to_be.body: The coverage agent reads the policy and returns the coverage result with clause citations. The adjuster accepts or overrides in one action.

graphic.title: Coverage Check Elapsed Time: As-Is vs Target

as_is.body: The adjuster waits for the body-shop estimate by fax or email, and variance against actual repair cost is only reviewed monthly.

to_be.body: The estimate agent compares each estimate to the regional benchmark and flags any variance above 15% before the adjuster approves.

personas.role_title: SIU Investigator, Claims Manager & Claims Finance Analyst
personas.location: Special Investigations Unit, Claims Management & Finance
personas.mission: Screens every claim for fraud, approves settlements within delegated authority, and releases payment without duplicates.

image.alt: Claims management team in a review meeting

as_is.body: Fraud screening is handled by email to the Special Investigations Unit, so only 8% of claims are screened before payment.

to_be.body: The fraud agent scores every claim through the external scoring service. The SIU investigator reviews only claims scoring 70 or higher.

graphic.title: Fraud Screening Coverage and Score Threshold

wireframe.section_title: Claims with fraud score of 70 or higher

rows: Loss reported 3 days after policy start

as_is.body: Authority limits live in a spreadsheet and claims above limit are routed by email, giving a 6.2 day average settlement cycle.

to_be.head_right: Rule-Based Routing to the Right Approver
to_be.body: The authority agent routes each settlement by amount: up to 5,000 to the adjuster, up to 25,000 to the team lead, above that to the claims manager. Target cycle is 2.5 days.

graphic.title: Settlement Authority Tiers and Cycle Time

as_is.body: Finance keys each payment by hand, and duplicate payments are found in 0.7% of payouts.

to_be.body: The payment agent prepares the payment in the treasury system with an automatic duplicate check. The finance analyst releases it. Target is zero duplicate payments.
